style.backgroundSystem: deep navy arena panel #0B1424 for the opening hero and the variant tech screen, clean white #FFFFFF for packshot and spec screens, light grey infographic panel #F2F3F5 for structure and detail screens, alternating for rhythm

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent high-energy indoor badminton sports ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, light grey #F2F3F5, deep charcoal #16181C and one high-voltage orange accent #F26522, with a deep navy arena panel #0B1424 reserved for the opening hero and the tech screen; bright even studio lighting with soft fill and soft contact shadows, raking side light for macro texture, cool blue arena glow #2E6FA7 for dark scenes; modern bold geometric sans-serif headline typography; consistent numbered orange ribbon tags and thin leader lines; clean high-end sports product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale and placement with the full racket frame silhouette always intact and balanced composition margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no visible brand marks or printed model names.
noDrift: no visible brand marks, printed model names or shaft lettering from any reference
style.presentationRules: stable product scale and placement across the set, full racket frame silhouette always intact, shaft lettering and printed markings never reproduced
style.surfaceSystem: seamless matte white studio surface #FFFFFF, light grey matte board #F2F3F5, polished indoor court wood #C79A5B and matte court green #2E6E4E for the scene shot
